passages.scope: Historical overview; not used as current legal rule or complete modern incentive formula.
Negotiated fee adjustment and min/max fee structure.
Target cost/profit, price ceiling, other-clause adjustment exception and possible loss.

authored: Numbers, formulas with fixed assumptions, six-row table, two curves, ceiling/zero-profit algebra and reflection prompts independently constructed. All C values assumed eligible for settlement and necessary funding/other performance conditions satisfied; no real payment entitlement adjudicated.
legal_scope: Specific US federal procurement structure used as a reference; no assumption it applies to Korean/private contracts or covers complete FAR rules/clauses.
delivery: No mobile-specific generation or viewport tests; prior phone output preserved by SHA256.
